timeline.summary: On May 12, 2026, Electronics Mart India commenced commercial operations at a new 5,200 sq ft Bajaj Electronics store in Pallakol, Andhra Pradesh.
Electronics Mart India reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,913.2 Cr, up 15.0% YoY, with PAT of ₹39.7 Cr.
Electronics Mart disclosed its Q4FY26 earnings call transcript outlining plans for ~20 store openings and entry into Kolkata.
Electronics Mart India filed its annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure confirming zero pledges as of March 31, 2026.
On June 8, 2026, Electronics Mart India commenced commercial operations at a new 8,300 sq ft Bajaj Electronics store in Karimnagar, Telangana.
